utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Saturday at the community center—fix bikes and appliances. Got it. I'll see if I can hunt down that old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh wait, Bo—I think you've got the wrong day! It's actually tomorrow at 10 AM, and we're fixing up the Smiths' fence, not bikes and appliances. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, what? Tomorrow? Ugh, sorry—I've got it all mixed up. I'll grab my toolbox and be there, then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Faye, I was just about to let you know—we've had to move the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. Hope you can still join us!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Rosa! Sunday at the community center works for me—I'll update my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Faye! I'm so glad that works for you—we'll have a good crew ready to tackle those fix-ups together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—right, that thing! I keep meaning to check my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Oren! It's this Saturday at the garage. I'll be there with my tools if you want to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, you say? Let me just jot that down before I forget again—I've got a memory like a sieve these days!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Noah, are you coming to the repair drive tomorrow? I've been rallying the whole block—it's at the community center at 10!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, tomorrow at 10? I thought it was in the afternoon—thanks for the reminder, Jules. I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I knew I could count on you! Bring your hammer if you have one—we'll be fixing up the Smiths' fence.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Ira, are you free this Saturday? We're hosting a repair drive at the community center to fix bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, perfect timing! I've got that squeaky lawn mower ready to go. Need me to help spread the word or pick up any parts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, the lawn mower would be a great project! Spread the word if you can — maybe ask around if anyone has spare screws or bike tubes they can donate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday, Leo? It's going to be a blast—lots of fixing and good company!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, 10am at my garage. Bring stuff to fix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo! I'll make sure everyone knows to head to your garage—this is going to be the best repair drive yet!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, you're just in time. I'm still trying to sort out what I can actually bring, but it's good to see you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I've got my toolbox ready and can throw in a couple of broken chairs to fix too. Need any help figuring out what to bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm finally hauling my old lawnmower over—maybe you've got something to fix too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've heard a little from Vik! I've got a lamp that's been flickering for weeks—maybe I'll bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, a flickering lamp, perfect! The volunteers love those kinds of fixes—I bet they'll have it working like new in no time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad you got it fixed, Ira's already asking about bringing his lawn mower this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I've got some spare parts and tools that should do the trick on that mower.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, do you have the right size wrenches for that mower's blade assembly?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, folks. Just a reminder, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM sharp at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Eli—are you sure it's 9 AM? I thought I heard morning, but I just want to double-check before I lock it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Hana, it's 9 AM sharp on Saturday. I've got the flyers posted around to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think they'll provide safety gear, but I'm bringing extra gloves if you need them. As for time, I'm planning to be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey. I'll bring my own gloves too, and I'll aim for 10 as well. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Cleo. I'll see you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira, I'm mapping out the repair drive stops. Do you have any addresses in mind where it should visit?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we really need all these stops? I still don't see why a whole drive is necessary.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, the more stops we have, the more folks can get their things fixed — it’s about covering the whole neighborhood, not just one spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my soldering iron and wrenches on Saturday. Should be useful for those lamps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Rey! The repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM sharp at the community center—I'm definitely bringing my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, 9 AM works for me. See you there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Dane, is it this weekend we're fixing stuff? I keep mixing up the dates.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it's Saturday at 10am at Leo's garage. I'm bringing my toolbox and some broken chairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Leo's garage Saturday at 10. I think I have an old toaster I can bring. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still don't see why we can't just handle things as they come. Are we sure this isn't turning into more trouble than it's worth?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Kira, you know, I think the repair drive is this Saturday... wait, was it Saturday? I'm getting the days mixed up again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday? Are you sure? I thought it was Sunday—did anyone actually confirm the date?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just don’t want us to be stuck if something breaks mid-week, you know? It’s a safety net.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I totally get it, Pia. We're mapping out stops so it's a reliable safety net — like Faye's suggestion at Maple and 3rd. Do you have a spot in mind we should add?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: How about my place on Oak Street? It's central and easy to reach, plus I can keep track of the schedule from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I heard there's a repair drive coming up—do you know when it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Ira! It's this Saturday at 10am at Leo's garage. You should come if you can—we could always use more help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll be there! My lawn mower's been squeaking for weeks—hope Rey's ready for it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa, do you know what kind of tools we need for the repair drive? I want to make sure I bring the right stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great question, Cleo! Since we're fixing fences, steps, and such, bring a hammer, screwdriver set, and maybe a level. Oh, and heads-up: the drive moved to Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sunday, got it. Are they providing any safety gear, or should I pack my own gloves and goggles?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, Jules—let's sync up on the flyer details after I grab the info. I'll double-check the start time from the bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I can help spread the word once you have the final details! Just let me know the time and I'll make sure everyone on the block knows.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn! I'll confirm the exact time from the board and share it with you and Jules as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive sounds perfect—my lamp's been flickering like crazy, can you point me to where I should take it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure Nell, bring it by Leo's garage this Saturday at 10am—I'll take a look at it for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks Gus, I'll be there—hoping it's just a loose wire or something simple.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Eli, are you coming to the repair drive tomorrow? Vik's bringing his toaster—it'll be a whole day of fixing stuff!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tomorrow? No, Jules, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM sharp. Vik must have mixed up the dates again. Check the flyer on the community board.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, you're right! I must've glanced at the wrong flyer. Thanks for the heads-up, Eli—I'll make sure to be there Saturday at 9 with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I'm just buzzing about this repair drive! I've got my old lawnmower ready to go, and Sam even offered to help me haul it over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, lawnmowers are tricky but fixable. I'll set aside a workbench for it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's so thoughtful of you, Leo! I was worried it might take up too much space, but having a dedicated bench sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help coordinating the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—right, that thing! I keep meaning to check my calendar. If you could give me a hand, I'd really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure thing, Oren! I can meet up after school pickup today to sort out the schedule. How does 3 p.m. at the café sound?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. We'll have tools and coffee ready, so bring any bikes or small appliances that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Have we got enough volunteers to cover the different repair stations yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We've got a few folks signed up, but we could always use more hands. Are you thinking of joining a station?
